reference.pathophysiology: Alpha 1 receptors contract vascular and prostatic smooth muscle through calcium signalling, so blockade dilates resistance vessels and relaxes the bladder neck. In phaeochromocytoma, chronic catecholamine vasoconstriction contracts plasma volume; irreversible blockade plus repletion prevents catastrophic swings when tumour catecholamines surge or suddenly cease at resection.
